name: fortnite-growth-lessons
description: Shared cross-project knowledge base of what actually worked or flopped in marketing/growth work (thumbnails, titles/tags, trailers, launch plans, patch-note tone, retention proposals) across every project set up with this kit — as opposed to what sounded good in theory. Read it before starting any of the 8 fortnite-* growth skills, and add to it once a real outcome (CTR/retention/reaction) is known, not at the moment of producing the asset.
